metadata.description: A marketplace for Claude Code skills by Henry Ventura

plugins.name: fetch-pr-comments
plugins.description: Fetch unresolved PR review comments and feedback on the current branch. Use when you need to address outstanding PR review items or see what feedback needs to be resolved.

plugins.name: create-skill
plugins.description: Create Claude Code skills with proper structure, frontmatter, and best practices. Use when creating new skills, writing SKILL.md files, or structuring Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: beads-agent-village
plugins.description: Set up and orchestrate multi-agent workflows using Beads (shared issue tracking/memory) and MCP Agent Mail (agent messaging). Use when coordinating multiple agents, setting up agent villages, or tracking work across agent sessions.

plugins.name: discord-dm
plugins.description: Send the user a Discord DM via a configured bot — text and/or file attachments in one CLI call. Use for proactive notifications, long-running task pings, or sharing screenshots when the user is away from terminal.
